description:
Backend Engineer — SDE Intern
 
**Sooru AI Private Limited** 
 · HSR Layout, Bengaluru
 
 · Hybrid ·
 
 Full\\-time Internship · 6 months
 


 About us
 
  





 Sooru AI is an AI\\-native ConTech company. We build
 **SpaceSync** 
 — a cloud BIM platform that lets architects go from a spatial program to a coordinated 3D model in minutes instead of weeks. Think "Figma for architecture": browser\\-native, real\\-time, collaborative.
 



 At the core is our patent\\-pending bidirectional sync engine, which keeps spreadsheets and 3D geometry in lockstep — edit a room area in a grid and the model updates; drag a wall and the numbers follow. It's a hard systems problem, and it's the thing you'd be helping build.
 



 We're a small founding team shipping to real architecture firms and enterprise partners.
 


 What you'll do
 
  




* Build and own REST and GraphQL endpoints that power SpaceSync's design modules
* Work on the sync engine — event pipelines, conflict resolution, and consistency between relational and document stores
* Implement async workloads with Celery for geometry processing, exports, and AI inference jobs
* Extend our real\\-time collaboration layer over Django Channels and WebSockets
* Write tests, review PRs, and ship to production behind feature flags — interns here merge code in week one, not month three



  




 Our stack
 
  





 Python 3\\.12 · Django 5\\.x · Django REST Framework · Strawberry GraphQL · PostgreSQL · MongoDB Atlas · Redis · Celery · Django Channels · Docker · AWS ECS Fargate
 



 You won't know all of it. We don't expect you to.
 



  




 What we're looking for
 * Pre\\-final or final year student, or a recent graduate available full\\-time on\\-site in Bengaluru
* Strong Python fundamentals and comfort with data structures, algorithms, and SQL
* Hands\\-on experience with Django or DRF — a personal project, a hackathon build, or coursework you can walk us through
* Working knowledge of Git and a habit of reading documentation before asking
* Genuine curiosity about how systems fail, and the patience to find out why



  




 Nice to have
 * GraphQL, Celery, WebSockets, or Redis in a real project
* Docker, CI/CD, or any AWS exposure
* Open\\-source contributions or a GitHub profile with things you actually built
* Interest in geometry, CAD/BIM formats (IFC), or computational design



  




 Why this internship
 * **Real ownership.** 
 You'll ship features used by practising architects, not internal tooling nobody sees.
* **Direct access.** 
 You'll work alongside the CTO and founding engineers. No layers.
* **Hard problems.** 
 Real\\-time sync, geometry pipelines, and multi\\-tenant architecture at scale.
* **A path forward.** 
 Strong interns get full\\-time offers.



  




 How to apply
 
 Send your résumé and GitHub/portfolio to
 **careers@sooru.ai** 
 with the subject line
 **"Backend SDE Intern — \\[Your Name]"** 
 . A short note on the most interesting thing you've built goes a long way.
 



**Process:** 
 Application → take\\-home assignment (\\~4–6 hours) → technical interview → conversation with the founders. We aim to close within 1 week.
 



  





*Sooru AI is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on evidence of ability, not pedigree.*
